overall_reason: Ant Design's own documentation built on its token set (1289 --ant-* references; type 99% on token values, radii 6 and 8px all on tokens); a design-system site is held to its scale, and it slips in a few places: 12.5 and 17px text and retyped literals.

score.reason: T-SCALE-FIT, T-TOKEN-TIERS and T-VALUE-INVENTORY pass; T-DRIFT-PAIRS finds 12.5 and 17px off Ant's scale, and T-HARDCODE finds 250 colour literals that equal tokens (TOK-012, TOK-006).

findings.evidence: Two sizes sit off Ant's own type scale (12, 14, 16, 20, 24px): the blockquote notes in the markdown body are 12.5px and the header version button label 17px (values.1440.font_size near_duplicates 12/12.5 and 16/17/18).
findings.after: Blockquotes at the 12px fontSizeSM token; the button label at 16px fontSizeLG
findings.why: A design system's documentation is the reference other teams copy, so off-scale values spread.

findings.evidence: 250 colour, 241 spacing, 64 font-size and 60 radius literals equal a declared token's value (declarations.literal_retypes_a_token_value), and 657 colour declarations are literal against 1976 var.
findings.before: Literals that repeat --ant-* values in the site's own rules
findings.after: The site's own rules reference the --ant-* tokens
findings.why: A kit's site that retypes its tokens shows readers the opposite of what it teaches.

strengths: Type sizes are 99% on token values (14px body on 170 elements, 12, 16, 18 and 24px around it).
Radii are 8, 6 and 4px, all on Ant tokens; durations sit on 100, 200 and 300ms.
The tokens are tiered: primitives (--ant-blue-1 to --ant-blue-10), semantic roles (--ant-color-bg-base, --ant-border-radius-lg) and component tokens (--ant-alert-default-padding).
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the dark theme: the dark class sets only React Flow's --xy-* tokens (a third-party widget); the site's own dark theme was not rendered
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no Ant token file supplied; drift was judged against Ant's known scale and the tokens the page declares
